verdict.rationale: Shortwave offers event-based 'triggers' (draft replies on email arrival, auto-labeling via custom AI filters) that provide recurring automated behavior, but these are reactive to email events rather than scheduled/time-based recurring jobs; there's no documented cron-like recurring workflow scheduler beyond one-off 'scheduled send'. missing for 10: explicit time-based recurring job scheduling, evidence of persistent multi-step workflow automation beyond single triggers, and any independent confirmation of trigger reliability.
